decisions: Blocked on extract_modules.py until one line changes. Plan._residue_reads feeds every non-movable top-level statement to free_names, which wraps it in a function body; this source's 'from __future__ import annotations' makes symtable raise SyntaxError, so the CLI traces back instead of printing a plan. Fix: build kept from statements that are not MOVABLE and not ast.Import or ast.ImportFrom. An import binds names and never reads any, and _unread_imports already handles the import block separately, so nothing else moves. damage.py has no future import, which is why step 1 never hit this. Verified clean with that one change applied.

Checks clean exactly as the map's four extractions name them, with C7 in support_champion_packets.py. Measured: support_scan 452 rendered, support_row_metadata 435, support_bailout 285, support_champion_packets 348, residue 483. Every file under 500 with no unit moved off the map.

support_scan.py is a leaf on data_registry alone, so the fan-out arm cannot fire on it however many readers repoint. support_bailout.py does not import champions.renata_glasc; the map's claim that the remainder loses that import is wrong, nothing in this module reads it.

The two asides the map reports stay unfixed here, on purpose: _ability is a public cached-row accessor in private clothing whose right home is ability_atoms.py, and C6 to C8 are three champions' mechanics living outside their champion modules. Both are behavior-neutral moves that belong to their own change, not to a size split.
